task: Stop codemie-code CLI conversation-sync re-send loops by fixing duplicate-payloadId outcome marking (with on-read queue healing), keeping the sync step from rewinding lastSyncedMessageUuid, deduping concurrent Claude hook appends, and adding a 50-per-run cap plus collapse of pending payloads to the newest per (conversationId, history_index, role).

key_reasoning.reason: Three components across the upload, session-state and agent-transform layers: the shared conversation syncProcessor (applyPayloadOutcome, syncUpdates, parseSourceIndex, new cap and collapse step), the session-state merge in sync-state-utils (and possibly the claude adapter merge in claude.session.ts), and the Claude ConversationsProcessor append path. Base M because each fix is localized and has a clear pattern. Bumped to L because syncProcessor is a core shared utility used by every agent (claude, codex, opencode, pi, gemini, copilot-cli, Desktop telemetry).

Closest patterns all exist in the repo: the pre-#557 map-over-all-ids marking, the codex/opencode/pi existingPayloads.some(...) already-queued dedupe, and Math.max monotonic merges. That puts the base at M, because the collapse by (conversationId, history_index, role) is new logic that has to keep the latest Claude Assistant continuation and give superseded records a terminal status that is never re-picked. It also must not break codex/opencode/pi sentinel ids (<id>@<index>). The concurrent-hook dedupe is read-then-append with no lock, so it narrows the race but does not close it. Bumped to L because the acceptance criteria list specific edge cases (duplicate payloadId with mixed success/pending records, digit-led vs letter-led UUIDs in parseSourceIndex, concurrent Stop/SubagentStop, collapse with continuations) and the existing syncProcessor tests only use unique ids. No current template covers these duplicate-id or error-path cases.

All four fixes and the 50-per-run cap are concrete. Still open: whether to remove lastSyncedMessageUuid from the syncUpdates or guard it as monotonic, whether the claude.session.ts merge is in scope, which terminal status superseded/collapsed records get, and how collapse treats turn continuations. Core is defined with a few gaps, so M.

About 4-5 source files modified (syncProcessor.ts, sync-state-utils.ts, claude.conversations-processor.ts, possibly claude.session.ts and conversations constants), plus 1-3 new or extended colocated Vitest files. Low end of the band: M.
